summary: Version 1.1.0 adds organization and operating visuals and uses the canonical alphabetical term index.

items.title: Organization and trial decisions
items.whatChanged: Added four illustrative organization arrangements and eight visuals covering context ownership, evaluation results, recovery, the trial schedule, complete cost, unit cost, productive reuse and the final decision.
items.why: The visuals help leaders compare coordination choices and the existing synthetic examples. Company sizes are illustrative total-company headcounts, not reorganization thresholds.

items.title: Headings and term index
items.whatChanged: Subsection titles omit decimal prefixes. The term index now uses alphabetical groups, one term per entry and linked printed-page references, matching the collection format.
items.why: Replaced dense paragraphs of quoted section titles with a scannable index. Page references are measured from the final PDF pagination; existing section links remain available.
